snippet.title: Nymble 1 - Official Trailer | How high can you climb?
snippet.description:
APP STORE: https://apps.apple.com/app/nymble/id1542527234

Join Jack on a magical journey up the never-ending beanstalk in *Nymble*, a turn-based puzzle platformer where every move matters!

Explore 100 handcrafted levels across 5 unique worlds filled with monsters, hazards, and brain-teasing challenges. Search for the seedling, plant it in the soil, and grow the beanstalk to reach the next level above. But be careful—enemies move after your turn, so you'll need to think ahead and plan your route carefully.

Play the online demo:
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/986248

FEATURES

▶ Turn-based puzzle gameplay that rewards strategy and planning
▶ 100 handcrafted levels across 5 unique worlds
▶ Unique enemies with special abilities and behaviors
▶ Challenging puzzles that require careful thinking and experimentation
▶ Vibrant pixel art and smooth handcrafted animations
▶ Original orchestral soundtrack
▶ Mobile-friendly swipe controls
▶ Optional in-app purchase to remove ads

ENEMIES WITH PERSONALITY

Encounter a wide variety of creatures, from shape-shifting slimes to living chess pieces. Some monsters stand in your way, while others may become the key to solving a puzzle—if you can outsmart them.

THINK BEFORE YOU JUMP

Every move counts. Swipe to move or jump over obstacles, interact with the environment, and solve increasingly challenging puzzles. Since enemies react after every turn, success comes from planning several steps ahead.

HOURS OF PUZZLE ADVENTURES

Put your puzzle-solving skills to the test as you climb higher and higher up the magical beanstalk. Defeat bosses, unlock new worlds, and discover fresh mechanics throughout your adventure.

Enjoying Nymble? Stay connected:

X (Twitter): https://x.com/NymbleGame

Keep on jumpin'
